# RangManch AI

> RangManch AI is an India-first AI creation platform for videos, images, templates, AI influencer workflows, and voice-led creator content.

RangManch AI helps creators, marketers, agencies, startups, and brands generate short-form videos, image assets, template-based creative, and reference-guided AI influencer visuals from a unified workflow.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://rangmanchai.com/)
- [Pricing](https://rangmanchai.com/pricing)
- [Video Studio](https://rangmanchai.com/create)
- [Image Studio](https://rangmanchai.com/images)
- [AI Influencer Studio](https://rangmanchai.com/influencer)
- [Templates](https://rangmanchai.com/templates)
- [Indian AI Voiceovers](https://rangmanchai.com/sarvam-ai-voiceovers)

## Product focus

- AI video generation for creator and campaign workflows
- AI image generation for ads, social, and branded visuals
- Guided template workflows for prompt and asset generation
- Reference-guided AI influencer creation and content ideation
- Indian-language and creator-oriented voiceover workflows
